mode: verbatim ingest through the remember tool (importance 0.5, no tags), the plugin's own background keyword expansion with claude-haiku-5-5 (thinking disabled), no embeddings; per-turn injection with default policy
how: remember.execute({text}) per memory (registered by the plugin's apply(ctx)); deployed = the injection block text() of systemPrompt.context('memory'): recall(data, query, now, sid) over loadStore(sid) with default policy (evidence threshold 0.30, queryGate 0.8, maxItems 6, maxChars 800, count cap by top evidence score) then render(); ranked = the candidates of that same recall() call with evidence C > 0, ordered by P, first 10, read from the plugin's own turn trace
notes: Package: dsh-fish-memory 1.6.1, lib/index.js imported unmodified; host peers (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools, dsh-llm, schemastery) are not installed: the plugin's own fallbacks are used.

Host glue stubbed: ctx/agent/session objects (tool registry, event listener table, systemPrompt.context collector, llm.stream), the clock. The plugin's apply(ctx) runs for real and registers its tool and injection block on them.

remember has two optional arguments the model normally fills in (tags, a fact key, a 'supersedes' text). They are left empty. importance is the tool's schema default 0.5. Memories are written in date order with Date.now() set to each memory's date (12:00 UTC + index seconds); questions run at the day after the last memory.

The plugin keeps one store per session. Every question runs as a fresh branch session of the ingest session, which the plugin mounts by copying the parent's memories (its own branch-inheritance path); this keeps questions independent of each other and leaves the 'own speaking style' ruler (needs 20 earlier messages) empty, as in a first turn.

The plugin's local de-duplication: 0 memories were recognised as repeats and reinforced instead of stored; 0 stored rows were marked superseded by the plugin's near-duplicate rule and are never recalled. Rows stored: 240 of 240.
Background keyword expansion: ran with the configured model; rows with expansion words: 240.

ranked = the plugin's evidence-scored candidates (C > 0) ordered by P = C x (base + freshness + importance + emotion weights); a question the query gate rejects as too contentless (or with no matching word) yields an empty list. The plugin has no top-k search call of its own; its trace keeps the top 24 candidates.
deployed = what the injection block returns for one turn. Questions rejected by the query gate: 0. deployed ms times text() only (it includes the plugin's own trace write to disk).

ranked/deployed scores are P (rounded to 3 decimals in the plugin's trace). The injected text carries no ids: deployed ids come from the same turn's trace 'picked' list, and the adapter checks that the number of bullet lines in the injected text equals it.
Write failures: 0. Question failures: 0. Returned items that could not be mapped to a memory id: 0.

LLM usage (provider anthropic, model claude-haiku-5-5, thinking disabled): see llm_usage; llm_cost_cny is left 0 here and the USD cost is computed by the caller from the token counts (bench/external/prices.json). The plugin asks for temperature 0.1 on every call: DeepSeek gets it, claude-haiku-5-5 rejects temperature/top_p/top_k so it is not sent (counted in dropped_params).

Expansion batches: 121 calls covering 240 memory slots; rows without expansion words after the queue drained: 0 (failed API calls: 0; the rest are outputs the plugin could not use or answered with no words). A failed expansion leaves the row as stored, un-expanded; the plugin ignores the error (its own behaviour, not changed).
